limitations: Generated labels are engineering assertions; no new independently reviewed representation/method/relation/next-test scientific utility labels.
Matched search candidates are fixed; Reasoner proposals are observed but cannot change this matched set. This does not measure autonomous Reasoner marginal value.
No semantic merge operation is implemented: zero false semantic merges is structural retention, not a learned merge-quality result.
Duplicate metric measures avoided exact semantic reassessment; it does not establish automatic avoidance of duplicate scientific work.
Native probabilities vary across repetitions; discrete policy/fit instability is reported separately.
Costs are unavailable when providers/SDK omit them; tokens/usage/calls/questions and elapsed time retain observed values only.

Source trajectory uses historical public data with prior exposure, scripted SDK choices and declared model assumptions. No fresh acquisition, independent replication, survival validity or clinical usefulness.
Scoped native installed executions are exercised; no current whole-environment/reusable promotion qualification is claimed.
